release_summary: Search independent SDH captions across languages without viewing-addon language filters. Preserves provider SDH/label metadata, reserves independent search capacity, spreads unknown captions across languages, and uses available viewing/embedded timestamp references when container indexes are missing. Adds bounded parallel candidate downloads and individual sanitized timing/description outcomes. Android build, selected regression suites and 61 analyzer/review checks passed. Actual SDH availability, cross-language timing accuracy and detection results require device verification. No OCR, audio analysis or automatic AI reporting.
